title: Review a video, two people
purpose: Two of our own reviewers watch every video before the client sees it, so bad footage stops here.
with: a second reviewer watching the same video alone, and Youssef Medhat for anything you are not sure of
when: Every day, after the overnight upload. You work remotely, as footage lands.
takes: All day. Every video is one 30-minute session.
needs: The wearer log for each site

steps.do: Take your queue from Youssef Medhat
steps.detail: Every session that landed overnight, with its device number, site, and shift.
steps.check: You know how many sessions are yours today.

steps.do: Match each session to a name in the wearer log
steps.detail: Who wore this phone, on which shift, at which site. A flag lands on a person, never on a phone.

steps.do: Watch the whole video, on your own
steps.detail: From the first second to the last. Never speed through one to hit a number.
steps.check: You saw the start, the middle, and the end.

steps.do: Check the angle, the light, and the movement
steps.detail: The camera sees the hands and the work. The light is good enough to see. The person is working.
steps.check: You can say what the person was doing.

steps.detail: One match is a flag. Not sure: send it to Youssef Medhat the same day. Nobody guesses.
steps.check: You can name the pattern, or say there was none.

steps.do: Delete on sight anything that must not exist
steps.detail: A restroom, a screen, an ID, a person under 18. Tell Youssef Medhat now.
steps.check: It is gone and Youssef Medhat knows.

steps.do: Log your verdict: keep, flag, or delete
steps.detail: Write the flag so the worker can fix it: what was wrong and what right looks like.
steps.check: The verdict is on the dashboard with the reason.

steps.do: Put the two verdicts together and send every flag to the Portfolio Manager
steps.detail: If either reviewer said delete, it is deleted. Both must say keep for the video to go to the client.
steps.check: Every flag reached the Portfolio Manager today, with the fix.

done: Every session that landed overnight has two verdicts, the bad footage is gone, and every flag reached the site today.

fails.if: Footage lands faster than you can watch it
fails.then: Do not skip a video. Tell Youssef Medhat the same day: the backlog is his to solve.

fails.if: The wearer log has no name for the session
fails.then: Do not guess. Send Youssef Medhat the session and the device number today.

fails.if: You and the second reviewer disagree
fails.then: The harder verdict wins. Flag or delete beats keep.

fails.if: The same problem shows on a whole site
fails.then: Flag each session as usual, then tell Youssef Medhat: one briefing or one rig is wrong, not ten workers.

fails.if: The client strikes a video you passed
fails.then: Say nothing to the client. Tell Youssef Medhat the same day so the team learns from it.

escalate: Youssef Medhat, the same day, for anything you are not sure of, a split verdict, or a backlog you cannot clear.
